g.title: KayaRank4Convo2 begins.
g.text: KayaRank4Convo2 begins.

g.title: j40062628
g.text: Nova?

g.title: j2217459864
g.text: Nova?

g.title: j3023071116
g.text: Kaya?

g.title: j1095144474
g.text: None of us would ever judge you.

g.title: j1344751994
g.text: What happened to you is a complete personal violation.

g.title: j1063848072
g.text: Someone violated your trust and tried to humiliate you.

g.title: j3599304286
g.text: You were vulnerable and you were betrayed.

g.title: j1346366185
g.text: Your world was pulled from under you.

g.title: j505380487
g.text: People looked at you differently.

g.title: j1002407475
g.text: Do you see why I need to get away?

g.title: j722808725
g.text: It's like, what happened to me had never happened to ANYONE.

g.title: j3415623974
g.text: It made headlines. People mocked me for pretending I was a victim of something when it was my own choice to share that photo.

g.title: j2074467183
g.text: You can't even look up my name in the student databases without people thinking of that 'STP', Slutty Teachers Pet.

g.title: j1633601060
g.text: And you guys will find the picture too and none of you will ever look at me the same again. Like any respect... gone. Forever

g.title: j1805025257
g.text: I have to get out, I have to move forward, to a time and place where I was smart enough to leave this all behind.

g.title: j421334132
g.text: There's nothing more for me to say. We've all done things we regret.

g.title: j4149189896
g.text: If anything I respect you more.

g.title: j2278114645
g.text: There will never be a moment where any of us judge you for this.

g.title: j538110091
g.text: Maybe one day you can tell me the biggest regret you have...

g.title: j3022223918
g.text: Don't F*** Lie to me.

g.title: j3051414897
g.text: Check boolean KayaEternalismTest

g.title: j626007672
g.text: Maybe I will. We have lots of time, after all.

g.title: j1764682337
g.text: It's a promise. You're not alone in this world. We're all just taking chances on other people.

g.title: j89168196
g.text: Not a lie. Just believe it. [End.]

g.title: j70057113
g.text: Hear me out.

g.title: j2366591228
g.text: You obviously figured out Eternalism, maybe better than I did.

g.title: j3051414897->j2366591228
g.text: true

g.title: j2072611246
g.text: Check boolean KayaAttitude

g.title: j3051414897->j2072611246
g.text: false

g.title: j636956295
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3706483799
g.text: Boolean KayaPromiseRegret is now true.

g.title: j943684840
g.text: Which is saying something.

g.title: j703387857
g.text: All that attitude you've given me? At least it makes sense, you were afraid AND angry. I was another stranger on the internet.

g.title: j2072611246->j703387857
g.text: true

g.title: j736710840
g.text: I will never talk you out of leaving 1999.

g.title: j2072611246->j736710840
g.text: false

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo3.

g.title: j636956295->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo3.
j3537367161
g.text: I'm sure there's a way. And it means more to you to go somewhere else, anywhere else.

g.title: j1407893468
g.text: Help is always here. I might be a better listener than time traveler, though. Don't be shy.
